semiconductor_relevance: High — Brooks Japan provides automation solutions, including collaborative robots, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Brooks Japan specializes in automation solutions for the semiconductor industry, showcasing their SCARA collaborative robot PF3400 at SEMICON. Their robots are designed for various applications, enhancing efficiency in manufacturing environments such as electronics and smart factories.

regional_presence.Japan: Brooks Japan has a significant presence in Japan, focusing on providing automation solutions tailored to the local manufacturing industry.
